surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the adsorption of Mg(Cp)2 precursor followed by a water pulse (H2O) to complete the surface reaction. The MgO growth occurs through a surface-controlled process where the Mg precursor reacts with surface hydroxyl groups, and subsequent water pulses regenerate the hydroxyl sites. The reaction is self-limiting due to the ALD process, ensuring monolayer-by-monolayer growth.
